name: Gyms & Fitness Studios
title: Referral Partners for Gyms and Fitness Studios | Our Local Network
description: We visit the juice bars, running stores and shops near your gym or studio in Elmhurst, Hinsdale and Oak Brook. You see every sign-up in your portal.
cardBlurb: We visit the juice bars, running stores and meal prep shops near you.
intro: We find businesses near you that see people who want to get fit. Every month we visit them and introduce your gym or studio by name.
partnersIntro: People who want to get moving stop at these places, and the staff know them.

partners.name: Smoothie and juice bars
partners.why: Their regulars stop in before or after a workout.

partners.name: Running and athletic stores
partners.why: People buying workout gear are starting or keeping up a routine.

partners.name: Meal prep shops
partners.why: Their customers are already working on how they eat.

partners.name: Hair salons and barbershops
partners.why: Neighbors of every age come in every few weeks and chat with staff.

partners.name: Apartment leasing offices
partners.why: New residents want a place to work out close to home.

partners.name: Bridal shops
partners.why: Couples and wedding parties often want to get in shape before the big day.

treatsIntro: We bring coffee and treats for everyone on shift, from the counter to the back office.
treatExamples: Coffee and bagels for a smoothie bar's opening crew
Muffins and coffee for a leasing office's morning team
Cookies and iced coffee for a barbershop's Saturday crew
portalNote: Each sign-up lands in your portal. Your front desk calls to book a tour or a first class.

notes.title: A one-page partner agreement
notes.text: When our team visits, you and each partner agree to promote each other. Nobody is paid per referral or per customer.

notes.title: Never another gym
notes.text: We never visit other gyms or fitness studios for you. Every stop is a business that doesn't compete.

notes.title: Your first-visit offer
notes.text: Each staff card opens your first-visit offer, written in your words.

exclusivity: When our team visits, partners agree to promote one gym or studio like yours, and only yours, for as long as you are a client.

faq.q: What if a business on the list feels too close to mine?
faq.a: Take it off the list. We only visit the businesses you approve.

faq.q: Can't I just walk into the juice bar next door myself?
faq.a: You can. The hard part is finding the right businesses, visiting every month and tracking every sign-up.

faq.q: Do I need to come along on the visits?
faq.a: No. Our field team makes every visit, and you see each stop in your portal.

aboutText: I'm asking about referral partners for my gym or fitness studio.
